name: ANONYMOUS;CODE
source:
"The fact that you've arrived here―rather, to this save point―at this moment in your life is nothing short of a miracle. It delights me to no end. Step through the stage's curtain; rip off the mask of the wizard who pulls the strings. Close the loop. Hack into God."

——February 6, 2036 - Time, 15:28:15

Every computer on Earth overflowed past the maximum limit of the 4,294,967,295 seconds granted within the Digital Standard Clock that had been ticking away since 1900, leading to the worst-case scenario: all Defense-Attack Systems throughout the world majorly malfunctioning. Military satellites roared like Hammers of God as they showered instant devastation upon the world's major cities. New York, London, Shanghai, Moscow, and Shinjuku. This large-scale disaster came to be known as "Sad Morning."  Was this simply judgment being handed down onto mankind? If so, then who could that judge be? Or instead, could this merely be the preface to a far greater calamity...? 

The curtains to the story of Anonymous;Code rise during an unsettling series of events set in Nakano, Tokyo - Year 2037.
translation:
“你能在此刻抵达这里——更准确地说，抵达这个存档点——本身就是奇迹。我对此无比欣喜。穿过舞台帷幕，撕下操纵一切的魔法师面具。闭合循环。入侵上帝。”

——2036年2月6日15:28:15

自1900年起持续运行的数字标准时钟，向地球上的每台计算机授予了4,294,967,295秒；当这段时间超过上限，最糟糕的情况发生了：全世界的防御攻击系统大规模失灵。军用卫星如“上帝之锤”般轰鸣，向世界各大城市倾泻瞬间的毁灭。纽约、伦敦、上海、莫斯科，以及新宿。这场大规模灾难后来被称为“悲伤的早晨”。这只是降临人类的审判吗？如果是，那么审判者又是谁？还是说，这仅仅是更大灾难的序幕……？

《匿名代码》的故事在2037年东京中野区一连串令人不安的事件中拉开帷幕。
